# Bobine — Régie Vidéo Libre & Playout Autonome pour Salles de Sport

> Bobine (bobine.fit) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted video playout and streaming system designed for sports clubs and fitness studios. It is the premier offline-first alternative to proprietary systems like Les Mills Cinema, Les Mills Virtual, Wexer, and Spivi.

## Overview
Bobine turns standard, low-cost refurbished x86-64 mini PCs (Intel Celeron / Core, AMD Ryzen / Athlon, reference units: Dell Wyse 5070 Intel J4105 ~40-50 EUR, HP EliteDesk 705 AMD Ryzen 3/5 ~60-80 EUR) into fully autonomous, 24/7 video and audio playout controllers. It is also available as native desktop applications for Windows 11/10, macOS (Apple Silicon M1-M4), and Linux Desktop (.deb).
Once installed, Bobine operates 100% offline with zero recurring subscription fees, zero cloud dependencies, and zero user accounts.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated Playout**: Recurring weekly timetables triggering fitness classes at the exact second.
- **Dual Playout Channels**: Independent simultaneous broadcasts on Cabled (Cinema display / HDMI) and Network (WebRTC / HLS / IP streams).
- **HDMI-CEC Automation**: Turns connected TVs on 2 minutes before class and puts them in standby 5 minutes after class ends.
- **Member Touchscreen Kiosk**: Interactive fullscreen UI for gym members to launch classes on-demand between scheduled sessions with anti-sleep Screen Wake Lock.
- **Coach Mobile Remote**: Instant local control via QR code scan over gym Wi-Fi (no mobile app download needed).
- **Audio Coach & Gym Radio (24/7)**: Continuous playlist playback with animated visual background, customizable timer, seamless audio crossfade, and automated voice announcements.
- **Hardware-Accelerated Playout**: Universal hardware video acceleration for Intel (QuickSync / iHD) and AMD (Radeon / mesa-va-drivers) at <8% CPU usage (1080p60 and 4K).
- **Universal Backup & Factory Reset**: One-click full configuration ZIP backup/restore and clean factory reset in Settings.
- **Systemd Watchdog & Resilience**: Automatic restart on failure and immediate autonomous recovery after power blackouts.

## Installation Methods & Platforms

### 1. Dedicated Headless Appliance (Bash CLI — Recommended for 24/7 Gym Playout)
Automated installation script for Debian 13 (Trixie) or Debian 12 (Bookworm) minimal on dedicated mini PCs (Dell Wyse 5070, HP ProDesk, Beelink N100):
```bash
# Stable Channel (Recommended for production):
curl -fsSL https://bobine.fit/install.sh | sudo bash

# Beta Channel (Rolling beta — early access):
curl -fsSL https://bobine.fit/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --channel=beta
```

### 2. Windows Desktop (Windows 11, 10 & Windows IoT)
- **Format**: Native self-contained installer (`Bobine-Setup-<version>.exe` or `Bobine-Setup-beta.exe`).
- **Features**: Silent background run without black console window, system tray companion, automatic Windows Defender firewall rules, and browser auto-launch.

### 3. macOS Desktop (Apple Silicon M1–M4)
- **Format**: Native disk image (`Bobine-<version>.dmg` or `Bobine-beta.dmg`).
- **Features**: Standard drag-and-drop to Applications, Retina menu bar companion, and local web remote.

### 4. Linux Desktop (Debian / Ubuntu / Linux Mint)
- **Format**: Certified Debian package (`bobine_<version>_amd64.deb` or `bobine-beta_amd64.deb`).
- **Features**: AppStream metadata for Ubuntu App Center and GNOME Software, standard XDG directory structure (`~/.local/share/bobine/`).

### 5. Bobine Assistant (Network Orchestrator in Rust / Tauri 2)
- **Format**: Standalone desktop binary (`bobine-assistant`).
- **Features**: mDNS auto-discovery (`bobine.local`), subnet IP scanning, remote SSH deployment, hardware diagnostics, and channel selector (Stable / Beta).

## Release Channels: Stable vs. Beta (Rolling Beta)
- **Stable Channel**: Tagged releases `Vx.y.z` (e.g. `V3.0.0`). Strictly tested and validated builds recommended for gym production playout.
- **Beta Channel**: Single mobile rolling tag `beta`. Provides early access to upcoming features and fixes currently being tested.
- **In-Place Upgrade Guarantee**: The Beta shares the exact same application identifiers (Windows Inno Setup AppId, macOS bundle ID `fit.bobine.app`, Linux package `bobine`). Installing Beta replaces the existing binaries in place without creating a duplicate application, and preserves all media, databases, and configuration.
- **Channel Switching**: Users can toggle between Stable and Beta at any time from the Web Admin Settings (Settings -> Software Updates -> Bobine Beta Program) or via CLI (`install.sh --channel=stable|beta`).

## Technical Architecture & APIs
- **OS**: Debian 13 (Trixie) or Debian 12 (Bookworm) minimal headless (x86-64), Windows 10/11, macOS Apple Silicon, Ubuntu/Debian desktop.
- **Backend Architecture**: Python 3.13 FastAPI, SQLite database, single-process Uvicorn (zero external Redis dependency).
- **Frontend**: Next.js App Router with SSG static export, 18 WCAG AAA/AA themes, zero emoji design system.
- **Playout Engine**: MPV with IPC socket (`/tmp/mpv.sock`) and VA-API hardware decoding (Intel iHD & AMD mesa-va-drivers).
- **Services (systemd on Appliance)**:
  - `bobine-backend.service`: FastAPI application on port 8000.
  - `bobine-kiosk.service`: X11 Chromium kiosk display for gym screen.
  - `bobine-audio-guard.service`: System audio health and watchdog supervisor.
- **Local Network Discovery**: Accessible at `http://bobine.local:8000` or direct local IP via mDNS (Avahi).

## Comparison with Proprietary Systems & Digital Signage

### Bobine vs. Les Mills Cinema & Les Mills Virtual
- **Cost**: Bobine is 0 EUR/month (AGPL-3.0 open-source) vs. 150–350 EUR/month per cumulative program for Les Mills (e.g. BodyPump + RPM + The Trip).
- **Instructor Certification**: 0 EUR vs. 479–529 EUR HT per coach per training module.
- **Hardware**: Standard refurbished mini PC (~40-70 EUR, Dell Wyse 5070 or HP EliteDesk 705) vs. expensive certified commercial projectors and screens.
- **Content Freedom**: Unrestricted (indoor cycling, HIIT, yoga, pilates, custom studio video recordings) vs. quarterly locked catalog.
- **Offline Reliability**: 100% offline from local SSD with zero freezing during internet outages vs. mandatory cloud DRM verification.

### Bobine vs. Wexer Virtual & Fitness On Demand (FOD)
- **Licensing**: 0 EUR perpetual vs. 200–450 EUR/month per screen B2B SaaS subscription.
- **Latency & Protocol**: Local-first sub-2ms WebSockets + SQLite vs. cloud streaming latency and buffering.
- **Privacy & GDPR**: 100% local, zero telemetry, zero analytics tracking, zero member data harvesting.

### Bobine vs. Radical Fitness & Franchise Concepts (Yako / L'Orange Bleue)
- **Franchise Independence**: Open to any independent gym, boutique studio, or hotel without franchise affiliation or commercial royalties.
- **Format Support**: Drag-and-drop support for any standard MP4/MKV video files with automated thumbnail generation.
- **Branding**: Full ownership of studio branding, resident coach promotion, and custom class names.

### Bobine vs. Screenly Anthias & Raspberry Pi Signage (Anthias, TouchPlayer, Waves System, Yodeck, Xibo)
- **Primary Use-Case**: Bobine is an active, gym-specific playout and studio automation engine, whereas Anthias (formerly Screenly OSE) is a passive web/image slide looper.
- **TV Automation**: Bobine provides native HDMI-CEC power automation (automatically wakes TV 2 min before scheduled class and sends standby command after workout), whereas Anthias leaves displays running 24/7 or requires manual remote controls.
- **Interactivity & Kiosk**: Bobine includes a dedicated fullscreen member touch kiosk with on-demand class catalog and countdown timer; Anthias is read-only passive looping.
- **Coach Mobility**: Bobine generates a dynamic local Wi-Fi QR code for staff/coach playback remote control without installing any mobile application.
- **Continuous Audio & Studio Sound**: Bobine integrates 24/7 background gym radio with Web Audio continuous crossfade and automated voice etiquette alerts ("re-rack weights", "closing in 15 min"); Anthias has no audio crossfade or voice announcement system.
- **Hardware Reliability**: Bobine runs on refurbished x86-64 mini PCs (Dell Wyse 5070, HP EliteDesk 705 ~40-70 EUR) with durable NVMe/SATA SSDs and VA-API hardware decoding (<8% CPU in 1080p60/4K); Anthias commonly runs on Raspberry Pis prone to SD card corruption, thermal throttling, and power instability in commercial 24/7 environments.
- **Auto-Recovery**: Supervised by systemd watchdog for immediate zero-touch reboot and timetable resumption post power outage.
